skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id one --wait
json-value id JOB
# A real backend read held after admission protects its output domain.
barrier logs arm
skygo-stream jobs logs $JOB &
barrier logs await
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'operation_pending'
barrier logs release
wait
stdout 'clock workload output'
await-prunable
# A second real stream has returned from backend I/O but is held in Write.
barrier http arm
skygo-stream jobs logs $JOB &
barrier http await
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'operation_pending'
barrier http release
wait
stdout 'clock workload output'
await-prunable
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
assert-native 0
assert-output 0
